Zini · Listen & Shadow 07

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
SCENE 1 · COLORS AND CONFIRMATIONS
👤 Colleague
How did the week go?
이번 주는 어땠어요?
go — (일이) 진행되다
💬 Zini
I felt much better this week — more comfortable with the whole thing.
이번 주는 훨씬 나았어요 — 전체적으로 마음이 편해졌어요.
comfortable — 편안한 · the whole thing — 전체 상황
같은 패턴으로 — I felt much better after the call. · She's more comfortable with the new buyer now.
💬 Zini
It's confirmed that the red color will not be accepted.
빨간색은 승인이 안 되는 걸로 확정됐어요.
confirm — 확정하다 · accept — 받아들이다
같은 패턴으로 — It's confirmed that the shipment leaves Friday. · It's confirmed that they want the black version.
💬 Zini
Color is a subjective matter, even for the experts.
색은 전문가한테도 주관적인 문제예요.
subjective — 주관적인 · matter — 문제, 사안
같은 패턴으로 — Fit is a subjective matter. · Taste is subjective, even for chefs.
💬 Zini
It's a matter of faith, in the end — they trust our eyes.
결국은 신뢰 문제죠 — 우리 눈을 믿어주는 거니까.
faith — 신뢰, 믿음 · in the end — 결국
같은 패턴으로 — It's a matter of timing, in the end. · It's a matter of trust — they believe our numbers.
💬 Zini
We're still waiting on the final call for the other two.
나머지 두 색은 아직 최종 답을 기다리는 중이에요.
wait on ~ — ~를 기다리다 · final call — 최종 결정
같은 패턴으로 — We're still waiting on the samples. · I'm still waiting on his answer.
SCENE 2 · CHASING THE CLOCK
👤 Colleague
How do you keep the deadlines?
납기는 어떻게 관리해요?
keep a deadline — 기한을 지키다
💬 Zini
We keep chasing — that's half the job.
계속 쫓아다녀요 — 그게 일의 절반이에요.
chase — 재촉하다, 쫓다
같은 패턴으로 — We keep chasing the supplier. · Chasing payments is half my job.
💬 Zini
Customers sometimes don't give us a deadline at all.
고객이 납기를 아예 안 줄 때도 있어요.
at all — 전혀
같은 패턴으로 — Sometimes they don't give us a size run at all. · He didn't give me a date at all.
💬 Zini
Those smaller factories have a fixed schedule — but it's too flexible.
작은 공장들은 일정이 정해져 있는데 — 너무 유연해요.
fixed — 정해진 · flexible — 유연한, 잘 바뀌는
같은 패턴으로 — They have a fixed price — but it's too flexible. · The plan is fixed, but it changes every week.
💬 Zini
If the sole slips, the whole line slips with it.
창이 밀리면 라인 전체가 같이 밀려요.
slip — 밀리다, 늦어지다 · line — 생산 라인
같은 패턴으로 — If the fabric slips, the cutting slips with it. · If one part is late, everything is late.
💬 Zini
We run three shifts to catch up.
따라잡으려고 3교대를 돌려요.
shift — 교대 근무 · catch up — 따라잡다
같은 패턴으로 — We run two shifts in the busy season. · They ran extra shifts to catch up.
💬 Zini
A mid-tier manager handles that — not me, not the floor.
그건 중간 관리자가 맡아요 — 저도 아니고 현장도 아니고.
mid-tier — 중간 급의 · the floor — 생산 현장
같은 패턴으로 — A supervisor handles that. · The QC team handles it, not sales.
💬 Zini
The estimate went from three weeks to five.
견적이 3주에서 5주로 늘었어요.
estimate — 견적, 예상
같은 패턴으로 — The estimate went from ten days to three weeks. · The price went from five to seven dollars.
SCENE 3 · WHAT WE TELL AUTRY
👤 Colleague
And what do you tell Autry?
Autry한테는 어떻게 말해요?
tell — 말하다
💬 Zini
For Autry, everything should be possible.
Autry한테는 모든 게 가능해야 해요.
possible — 가능한
같은 패턴으로 — For a buyer like that, everything should be possible. · For our best client, nothing is off the table.
💬 Zini
Nothing can't be promised — that's how we work with them.
약속 못 할 건 없어요 — 우리가 일하는 방식이 그래요.
promise — 약속하다
같은 패턴으로 — That's how we work with big buyers. · That's how we've always done it.
💬 Zini
We handle it by flagging it early.
문제는 미리 알려서 대응해요.
handle — 처리하다 · flag — 미리 알리다
같은 패턴으로 — We handle it by calling first. · We handle delays by sending a new date right away.
💬 Zini
I'd rather tell them now than surprise them later.
나중에 놀라게 하느니 지금 말하는 게 낫죠.
I'd rather A than B — B보다 A하겠다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd rather lose a day than lose the order. · I'd rather ask now than guess later.
💬 Zini
What I can promise is a date. What I can't promise is the weather.
제가 약속할 수 있는 건 날짜예요. 못 하는 건 날씨고요.
weather — 날씨
같은 패턴으로 — What I can promise is the quality. What I can't promise is the price. · What I can promise is my best.
💬 Zini
To prevent it happening again, we changed the supplier.
다시 안 생기게 하려고 공급사를 바꿨어요.
prevent — 막다 · supplier — 공급사
같은 패턴으로 — To prevent that, we added one more check. · To prevent it, we moved the deadline up a week.
💬 Zini
The one that keeps us up at night is the exchange rate.
제일 신경 쓰이는 건 환율이에요.
exchange rate — 환율 · keep someone up at night — 밤잠을 설치게 하다
같은 패턴으로 — The one that keeps us up is the raw material price. · The thing that worries me most is the timing.
💬 Zini
We've been hit by a bad batch before — once was enough.
불량 배치는 전에 한 번 겪었어요 — 한 번이면 충분했죠.
batch — 생산 묶음 · once was enough — 한 번이면 충분했다
같은 패턴으로 — We've been hit by a late ship before. · Once was enough — we never did that again.
💬 Zini
I'll accompany the shipment myself if I have to.
필요하면 제가 직접 화물을 따라갈 거예요.
accompany — 동행하다 · shipment — 화물, 선적
같은 패턴으로 — I'll go with the samples myself if I have to. · She accompanied the buyer to the factory.
💬 Zini
That's what it takes to keep a buyer like Autry.
Autry 같은 바이어를 지키려면 그 정도는 해야죠.
what it takes — 필요한 것 · keep — 유지하다
같은 패턴으로 — That's what it takes to win a new client. · That's what it takes in this business.
느리게 25/25 · 보통 25/25
